provenance.publisher: NBA Referee Operations (official NBA injury report, published on the NBA's own CDN)
provenance.document_title: Injury Report: 11/14/26 05:15 AM (multi-page; full text captured verbatim)
provenance.cadence_note: Per the official index (fetched this session): teams file by 5 p.m. local the day before a game (1 p.m. local game-day for the second night of a back-to-back); a game-day report is filed between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. local (8-10 a.m. for early tips); 'Reports are updated on a continual basis throughout the day' - hence the 15-minute PDF cadence. A probe of the 05:30 AM release at retrieval time returned S3 AccessDenied (unpublished), so this 05:15 AM release was the freshest published.
provenance.retrieval_method: platform page-fetch tool (direct curl to ak-static.cms.nba.com is blocked from the build sandbox)

revision_note.basis: Row-level comparison (game_date, matchup, team, player -> status, reason) against the two committed prior captures.
revision_note.result: No status changed on any row shared with the 19:30 ET release or the window snapshot. This release adds the 2026-11-15 game blocks (18 placeholder rows for 9 games - day-before designations for 11/15 are not due until 5 p.m. local today).

attribution_key.E: Team cell printed explicitly on the same row as the player (or the placeholder row).
attribution_key.C: Team cell lost to a page break in the text extraction; team carried from the last team label printed in that game block before the row (established convention). No row in this release needed a cross-release override.

time_convention.stored_as: the printed 12-hour cell, verbatim (e.g. '07:00', '01:00'), matching the prior injury captures' column semantics
time_convention.note: Irregularity I-03 of session arena/e77ce5ad-nba2: prior captures documented only '07:00 (ET) -> 19:00'. The rule above is now explicit and is enforced by nba2.pipeline.refresh.printed_game_time_to_24h (unit-tested).

flags.issue: 'Team submission outstanding at report time' is the repo's established display convention for rows the PDF prints as 'NOT YET SUBMITTED' (the PDF prints no reason cell for them). It is a labelled convention, not PDF text.

flags.field: time_et of the CHI@MIN and DET@MIA blocks
flags.issue: This extraction lost the tip-time cell for both blocks (page breaks), so time_et is blank on those 12 rows - blanks stay blank. The tip times (both 8:00 PM ET) are verified at the official games page and recorded in official_game_times_2026-11-14_0515AMET.json with time_captured=false.
flags.action_required: None - values live in the times capture with honest provenance.

flags.issue: Team cell lost to a page break; attributed to Brooklyn Nets (C) per the block convention - the row prints inside the BKN@MEM block after the five explicit Brooklyn rows and before the Memphis placeholder row.
flags.action_required: Spot-check the PDF rendering at the source URL if the attribution matters.

flags.issue: No official release yet lists 11/16-11/17 designations (they appear in the releases for their own game days). Those 13 window games have no injury rows to show - absence is coverage state, not missing transcription.
flags.action_required: Re-run the ingest when the game-day releases publish (nightly workflow, .github/workflows/refresh.yml).
